dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch3g_watch_sho:
A scorched page. ...That burn is lightning.
Tools remember. Their owners, less so. This page was someone's tool too. ...Keep it well.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch3g_watch_tel:
Seen the tower halfway up the peak? One streak of its stone is burnt blue.
There is a pillar on top. Lightning always picks it. The warden there never leaves its side. ...Lure it close. The lightning will cut for you.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch3g_pilla:
This is the rest of grandmother's story. The wind people took the storm bird for the sky's shadow. ...Even so, they knew lightning well.
They raised copper pillars and let it down into the earth. There should still be stands for them at the ruined tower on the peak. Four. Grandmother said four.
When she counted the stands, grandmother folded her fingers. At the fourth she made a fist. ...Like covering your ears before the thunder.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch3g_s_ver:
...Three, do not look up.
The third line of the children's song. Maybe "do not look up" was never about the bird. Even that bird hid its face, didn't it?
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch3g_c_st:
Three of them now.
...I have decided. I am staying. If no one remembers, the sky you climbed and the fire that waited here will be as if they never were.

Take this. A warm stone. Hold it and it stays warm.
...When you hear about the mountain of ash, remember me. I will be here, counting, waiting.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch3g_ston:
The stone under the peaks does not let lightning through. ...My grandfather's saying.
Someone told me the traveller before you wore that stone on their chest. It lies deep. Dig with an iron pickaxe. Five will do.
lore.skyabyss.ch3.mirror_lag.body:
Your figure showed in a feather mirror in the hall of the eye.

When you lowered your arm, the reflection still held it up. A moment later, it lowered its arm too.

Then, before you turned, the reflection turned to face you.
lore.skyabyss.ch3.mirror_lag.title: The Shadow That Lagged
lore.skyabyss.ch3.pillars.body:
When copper rods stood on the four stands at the ruined tower, lightning came down to each, one by one.

The wind people seem to have let lightning into the earth through copper pillars. Along the stands' edges, tally marks are bound in fours.

Only the fourth bundle was cut deeper.
lore.skyabyss.ch3.pillars.title: Pillars of the Wind People
lore.skyabyss.ch3.scorched_watch.body:
The pillar atop the tower had taken lightning so many times it was burnt blue. The coat of the warden that kept it was scorched the same colour.

At the pillar's foot lay a scorched page, a watch log of the wind people: "Strikes today, nine again. The warden did not move."

Was it the tower keeping watch, or the warden?
lore.skyabyss.ch3.scorched_watch.title: The Scorched Watch
lore.skyabyss.ch3.stayer_returns.body:
Behind the copper door of the ruined tower, in a stone box, lay one sheet of the wind people's writing.

"The stayer came again. The same coat as before, the same road as before. This makes the ninth sheaf of tallies. That one looks to the sky before the bird does."

In the margin, one line in another hand: "Four copper. As many as the stands."

The writing looked like the writing on the page in the pit.
lore.skyabyss.ch3.stayer_returns.title: The Stayer Came Again
message.skyabyss.ch3g.arrive.ch3_gleaner: In places the sand has fused like glass. Burnt cargo lies scattered, and something has been gathering it up.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.arrive.ch3_scorche: One streak of the tower's stone is burnt blue.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.arrive.ch3_wind_cl: A stage of rock juts from the cliff's edge. From here you can see the path the storms take.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.arrive.ch3_wind_fl: Fine copper wire is wound round the flag post. The flag points downwind.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.field.cache: At the bottom of a burnt crate, lumps of copper remain. Left behind by whatever gathers here?
message.skyabyss.ch3g.field.cache_empty: The crate is empty. Only the fresh claw marks have grown in number.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.flags.turn: As you stand at the fifth flag, every flag on the peak snaps round at once to face the other way. The wind has not changed.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.mirror.1: Your figure shows in a polished copper feather.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.ready: You are ready for the peaks.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.ruin.open: Lightning struck the fourth rod, and the tower's copper door slid aside with a grind.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.ruin.stands: Four empty stands circle the broken tower, each with a hole for a rod.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.ruin.strike: Lightning came down to the rod you raised.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.ruin.vault: In the stone box: a sheet of the wind people's writing, and four copper.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.ruin.vault_empty: Only a copy of the writing remains in the box.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.watch.page: A scorched page lies at the foot of the pillar.
message.skyabyss.ch3g.watch.warn: The air round the pillar starts to crackle.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.lightning_pillars.don: "Four, standing? ...Just as grandmother said. Lightning falls only where something is raised for it."
quest.skyabyss.ch3.lightning_pillars.rai:
The storyteller said: "The wind people let the lightning down into the ground with copper pillars. There should be four stands left at the ruined tower on the peak."
Copper ore smelts into copper in a furnace. Three copper make one lightning rod.
Make lightning rods and raise them on the ruin's stands
quest.skyabyss.ch3.lightning_pillars.sum: Raise four copper rods at the ruin of the wind people's tower.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.lightning_pillars.vau: When the fourth rod took the lightning, the tower's copper door slid aside. Look inside.
The traveling artisan said: "There is a burnt tower halfway up the peak. Every time lightning hits the pillar on top, the warden there burns a little more. ...Lure it to the pillar. The lightning will cut for you."
In the middle room, lightning jumps between people who stand together. Spread out.
Fell the warden atop the Scorched Watch
quest.skyabyss.ch3.scorched_watch.done: "Burnt by lightning, and still the writing stays. ...Tools are like that too."
quest.skyabyss.ch3.scorched_watch.show.j: At the foot of the top pillar you picked up a scorched page. Show it to the traveling artisan.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.scorched_watch.show.t: Show the scorched page to the artisan
quest.skyabyss.ch3.scorched_watch.summar: Climb the scorched tower on the peak's slope and fell the warden at the top.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.scorched_watch.title: The Scorched Watch
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sky_stone.dig.journal:
Isana said: "The stone under the peaks does not let lightning through. The traveller before you wore it on their chest."
Diamonds lie in the rock deep down, and only an iron pickaxe will dig them. Five make a chestplate or a sword.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sky_stone.done: "Stone from deep down. ...Even the thunder bird cannot bite through that."
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sky_stone.summary: Dig the stone beneath the peaks that lightning cannot pass.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.sky_stone.title: Sky Stone
quest.skyabyss.ch3.wind_flags.done: The flags still snap against the wind.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.wind_flags.summary: Follow the five flags along the ridge.
quest.skyabyss.ch3.wind_flags.title: Flags of the Wind Road
quest.skyabyss.ch3.wind_flags.trace.flag: Follow the flags of the wind road
quest.skyabyss.ch3.wind_flags.trace.jour: Flag posts wound with fine copper wire are said to line the ridge. The flags show which way the wind blows.
